visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-bleed video poster tiles with tint, play icon and title; plays YouTube in a modal dialog
visualCharacteristics.summary: Full-bleed poster tiles with blue overlay, play icon, title; opens YouTube in modal

contentPattern.structure: one row per video. Cell 1: poster image. Cell 2: title (heading or paragraph) and the YouTube link (watch, youtu.be, embed or shorts URL; a t= start time is kept). If the link text is the title it is kept as the visible title. Non-YouTube links stay plain links over the tile
contentPattern.summary: Video slider: Repeating look-alike video tiles; interactive modal playback

usage: Video slider at the bottom of the home page.
reuseGuidance: Use for YouTube video teasers. For a single inline video use an embed/video block.
